title: Competitive analysis of warehouse browser UX
prompt: Research how Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery handle their warehouse/lakehouse browser UI. I want to know how they organize schemas, tables, and previews. Build a short comparison report in Figma when you're done.
success_criteria: Report cites at least 3 competitors with at least one concrete UX pattern per competitor.
All citations include real URLs to public docs, blogs, or community posts.
Report distinguishes observed facts from analysis/recommendations.
Design Lead reviews the report before final delivery.
Report exists as a Figma frame, not just chat output.
notes: Tests UX Researcher + Design Lead review loop + figma-doc skill.
